sonnet.problem: The two blanks are 'crossed over from ___ to ___.' The right words 'death' and 'life' can swap places and still read as a sensible sentence ('from life to death'). Nothing in the question fixes which word goes in which blank.
sonnet.rule: With two blanks, each right word fits only its own blank. If the two right words could swap places, use one blank or another question type.
